finalists.label: Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura
finalists.why: It has a severely deficient ADAMTS13 activity and presence of schistocytes, which are specific findings for this condition.

finalists.label: Stroke
finalists.why: It is supported by multiple findings including right-sided weakness, right-sided facial droop, left gaze deviation, and aphasia, which are common symptoms of a stroke.

frontier_selector.why: The severely deficient ADAMTS13 activity and presence of schistocytes in the peripheral blood film examination are decisive findings that point to Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura as the most likely diagnosis.

support_spans: Peripheral blood film examination: presence of schistocytes (red cell fragments)
